faq.title: Help Center
faq.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions

howItWorks.question: How does shipping work on Swap?
howItWorks.answer: When you accept a swap, both parties are responsible for shipping their items. We recommend using tracked shipping methods and keeping receipts until both parties confirm receipt. You can coordinate shipping details through our built-in messaging system.

whoPays.question: Who pays for shipping?
whoPays.answer: Usually, each party pays for shipping their own item. However, this can be negotiated as part of the trade agreement. Some users offer to cover shipping for high-value swaps or as a gesture of goodwill.

damaged.question: What if my item is damaged during shipping?
damaged.answer: We highly recommend using insured shipping for valuable items. If an item arrives damaged, document it immediately with photos and contact the other party via our messaging system. For unresolved disputes, our support team can help mediate.

international.question: Can I ship internationally?
international.answer: Yes! Swap supports international trades. Make sure to discuss shipping costs and customs requirements with your swap partner before finalizing the agreement. Be aware that some items may have import/export restrictions.

timeline.question: How long should shipping take?
timeline.answer: Domestic shipping typically takes 3-7 business days. International shipping can take 1-4 weeks depending on the destination. We recommend agreeing on a shipping timeline with your swap partner and sharing tracking info.

howItWorks.question: How does trading work on Swap?
howItWorks.answer: Swap allows you to exchange items directly with other users. Browse items, make offers, negotiate via our secure messaging, and finalize swaps. Our rating and verification system helps ensure safe trades.

safety.question: How can I ensure my trades are safe?
safety.answer: Meet in public places, check profiles and reviews, use our messaging system for all communication, and document item condition with photos. Trust your instincts and report any suspicious behavior.

disputes.question: What should I do if there's a dispute?
disputes.answer: First, contact the other party via our messaging. If the issue persists, our support team can help mediate. Document everything with photos and messages. We have policies to handle disputes fairly.

misrepresentation.question: What happens if someone misrepresents an item?
misrepresentation.answer: Report the issue through our support system with photos and documentation. We take misrepresentation seriously and may suspend accounts that violate our policies. Always check reviews and profiles before trading.

fees.question: Are there fees for trading?
fees.answer: Swap is free to use for basic trading. We offer optional Premium features like listing highlights and priority support for a small monthly fee. There are no transaction fees or commissions on swaps.

create.question: How do I create an account?
create.answer: Click 'Sign Up' and provide your email, create a password, and choose a username. You can also sign up via Google or Apple for faster registration. Complete your profile by adding a photo and bio to build trust with other swappers.

editProfile.question: How do I edit my profile?
editProfile.answer: Go to your Dashboard and click on your profile picture or username. From there, you can update your photo, bio, location, and preferences. Keeping your profile updated helps build trust with potential swap partners.

delete.question: How do I delete my account?
delete.answer: Go to Dashboard > Settings > Account and scroll to 'Delete Account'. Note that this action is permanent and will delete all your listings, trade history, and reviews. Complete all ongoing trades before deletion.

verification.question: What do the verification badges mean?
verification.answer: Verified badges indicate that a user has confirmed their identity through our verification process. This includes email, phone, and optionally ID verification. Verified users tend to have more successful swaps.

changePassword.question: How do I change my password?
changePassword.answer: Go to Dashboard > Settings > Security and click 'Change Password'. You will need to enter your current password and choose a new one. We recommend using a strong, unique password and enabling two-factor authentication.

blockUser.question: Can I block another user?
blockUser.answer: Yes. Go to the user's profile and click the three-dot menu, then select 'Block User'. Blocked users cannot message you or see your listings. You can manage blocked users in your account settings.

free.question: Do I have to pay to use Swap?
free.answer: No! Swap is completely free for basic trading. You can list items, browse, message other users, and finalize swaps at no cost. Premium features are optional and offer enhanced visibility and support.

features.question: What are Premium features?
features.answer: Premium includes highlighted listings in search results, priority customer support, advanced analytics on your listings, and early access to new features. Premium subscribers also get a special badge on their profile.

cancel.question: How do I cancel my Premium subscription?
cancel.answer: Go to Dashboard > Settings > Subscription and click 'Cancel Premium'. Your premium features will remain active until the end of your current billing period. You can resubscribe at any time.

safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.subtitle: Learn how to swap with confidence and protect yourself from potential issues

howToSwap.title: How to swap safely
howToSwap.description: Follow these guidelines to ensure smooth and secure trades

reviewProfiles.title: Review profiles carefully
reviewProfiles.description: Check user ratings, reviews, and verification status before accepting a trade. Look for established users with a history of successful swaps.

communicateApp.title: Communicate through the app
communicateApp.description: Keep all conversations on our platform. This creates a record and helps our support team assist you if any issues arise.

documentItems.title: Document your items
documentItems.description: Take clear, well-lit photos showing all angles and imperfections. This prevents misunderstandings and disputes.

honestCondition.title: Be honest about condition
honestCondition.description: Accurately describe your item's condition, including any flaws. Transparency builds trust and prevents conflicts.

honestReviews.title: Leave honest reviews
honestReviews.description: After completing a swap, leave fair feedback. This helps other users and contributes to a trustworthy community.

meetingPerson.title: Meeting in person
meetingPerson.description: Best practices for secure in-person trades

safeLocation.title: Choose a safe location
safeLocation.description: Meet in public, well-lit areas with plenty of people. Cafes, malls, and police station 'safe exchange zones' are ideal.

daylightHours.title: Meet during daylight
daylightHours.description: Schedule meetings during the day whenever possible. If evening is unavoidable, choose a well-lit, busy location.

bringFriend.title: Bring a friend
bringFriend.description: Consider bringing someone with you, especially for high-value swaps. Safety is in numbers.

shareLocation.title: Share your location
shareLocation.description: Let a friend or family member know where you're going and when you plan to be back. Share your live location if possible.

inspectBefore.title: Inspect before swapping
inspectBefore.description: Take time to inspect the item thoroughly before completing the trade. Don't feel rushed or pressured.

reportingScams.title: Reporting scams
reportingScams.description: What to do if you encounter suspicious activity

warningSigns.title: Identify red flags
warningSigns.description: Beware of pushy users, those who refuse in-person meetings, ask for payment outside the app, or offer deals that seem too good to be true.

reportImmediately.title: Report immediately
reportImmediately.description: Use the 'Report' button on profiles or messages if you suspect fraudulent activity. Our team reviews all reports promptly.

documentEverything.title: Keep records of your transactions
documentEverything.description: When in doubt, save your messages and take screenshots. Documenting inappropriate behavior helps us maintain a safe platform for all swappers.

protectInfo.title: Protect your information
protectInfo.description: Never share sensitive personal info like your address, financial details, or copies of ID documents with other users.

quickTips.trustInstincts: Trust your instincts — if something feels off, it probably is
quickTips.noMoneyFirst: Never send money or items before receiving the item from the other party
quickTips.trackedShipping: Use tracked shipping for all postal trades

emergency.title: Emergency situation?
emergency.description: If you feel you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services first. Then, report the incident to us so we can take appropriate action on the platform.
